accommodation.notes: Default worker is a live-in foreign domestic helper. The employer must provide suitable accommodation free of charge (Labour Department FAQ). Other workers are not covered; no housing standard or price was read for them.

source.publisher: Labour Department (Hong Kong), foreign domestic helpers, frequently asked questions

food.notes: The employer must give free food or a food allowance of at least HK$1,236 a month (unchanged from 30 September 2025). Low is free food. With the allowance the helper pays for food herself, so typical and high are the allowance.

source.publisher: Hong Kong Government press release of 29 September 2025: Minimum Allowable Wage HK$5,100, food allowance unchanged

other_sources.publisher: Labour Department (Hong Kong), foreign domestic helpers, frequently asked questions

transport.notes: Assumed 8 journeys a month (4 rest days, 2 each) times 4.0 (cheapest MTR fare), 15.7 (Citybus top fare on Hong Kong Island) and 30.0 (Citybus top Kowloon and New Territories fare), single adult fares. The 8 journeys is an assumption.

source.publisher: Transport Department (Hong Kong), fact sheet on transport, July 2025

phone_data.notes: csl local prepaid SIM cards: 48 (6 GB), 58 (student), 78 (simple communication) and 98 (monthly SIM, flexible data packs); typical is the midpoint of 48 to 98. Voice allowances per plan were not read.

source.publisher: csl (Hong Kong), local prepaid SIM cards

mandatory_deductions.notes: Domestic employees, including live-in helpers, are exempt from the Mandatory Provident Fund. The employer pays work-injury insurance and medical care. Unlawful deductions are an offence. Salaries tax was not checked.

source.publisher: Mandatory Provident Fund Schemes Authority (Hong Kong), MPF coverage

other_sources.publisher: Labour Department (Hong Kong), foreign domestic helpers, frequently asked questions

transport_card.notes: Adult Standard Octopus: HK$50 refundable deposit plus HK$150 first stored value, which is spent on rides. Low counts the deposit only.

source.publisher: Octopus Cards Limited (Hong Kong), Standard Octopus

agency_commission.notes: The most a licensed agency may charge the helper: 10% of the first month's wage, payable only after that wage is received. On the HK$5,100 minimum that is 510. What an agency actually charges was not read.

source.publisher: Labour Department (Hong Kong), foreign domestic helpers, frequently asked questions

other_sources.publisher: Hong Kong Government press release of 29 September 2025: Minimum Allowable Wage HK$5,100, food allowance unchanged
